newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends losing streak, techs recover.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends losing streak, techs recover.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks ended the week on an upswing, after four disappointing sessions that rattled technology stocks.

The Nasdaq Composite Index jumped 11.29 points, or 0.84 percent, to close unofficially at 1357.69. The Dow industrials gained 83 points to an unofficial close of 6856. The long bond gained 21/32 to yield 6.71 percent.
Markets briefly lost ground in the afternoon after Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin's coment on the dollar put a crimp in the bond market that spilled over into stocks.
"There was some nervousness in the afternoon as stocks followed the bond market. But as some of the bellwether techs held their own, the market came back," one trader said.

Intel Corp recovered after sharp losses earlier this week, gaining 3-1/4 to 156-3/8, as a Hambrecht & Quist analyst reiterated his bullish view on the stock. Microsoft Corp and Sun Microsystems Inc also rebounded Friday. 3Com Corp was less fortunate, falling 1-1/2 to 50-3/4 after two brokerage firms downgraded the computer networking company.
Telecommunications component maker Ciena Corp surged on its first day of trading, gaining 14 to 37.
